summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen had been confined to bed since Tuesday, after being thrown from his buggy the previous Saturday when his horse became uncontrollable; his illness was painful but not thought serious.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Thursday, September 15, 1892, page 12.

facts.fact: Allen was thrown from his buggy during his usual afternoon drive when his horse became uncontrollable
Allen was confined to bed with a very painful illness from the shaking up, not thought to be serious

notes: Dates computed from 'last Saturday' and 'since Tuesday' relative to Thursday, Sept 15, 1892. Same event as the unnumbered (000) facts-index entry 'Early September 1892 ... Allen was thrown into a post while driving'.
